verse.verse_1: By the dipersing winds that disperse.
verse.verse_2: And the clouds bearing a load.
verse.verse_3: And the ships that glide with ease.
verse.verse_4: And the angels who distribute the affair.
verse.verse_5: Verily that wherewith ye are threatened is surely true.
verse.verse_6: And verily the Requital is surely to befall.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven full of paths.
verse.verse_8: Verily ye are in a divided opinion.
verse.verse_9: Turned aside therefrom is who is turned aside.
verse.verse_11: Those who are in heedlessness neglectful.
verse.verse_12: They ask: when is the Day of Requital coming?
verse.verse_13: It will be the Day whereon in the Fire they will be burned
verse.verse_14: Taste your burning: this is that which ye sought to be hastened.
verse.verse_15: Verily the God-fearing will be amid Gardens and water- springs.
verse.verse_16: Taking that which their Lord will vouchsafe Unto hem. Verily they have been before that well-doers.
verse.verse_17: Little of the night they were wont to slumber.
verse.verse_18: And in the dawns they prayed for forgiveness.
verse.verse_19: And in their substance was the right of the beggar and non- beggar.
verse.verse_20: And on the earth there are signs for those who would be convinced.
verse.verse_21: And also in Your own selves. Behold ye not?
verse.verse_22: And in the heaven is Your provision and that which ye are promised.
verse.verse_23: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth it is sure, even as it is a fact that ye are speaking.
verse.verse_24: Hath there come Unto thee the story of Ibrahim's honoured guests?
verse.verse_25: When they came in Unto him, and said:'peace!' he said: 'peace'! - people unknown.
verse.verse_26: Then he turned away privately Unto his household, and brought a calf fatted.
verse.verse_27: And he set it before them, and said: wherefore eat ye not?
verse.verse_28: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: fear not. And they gave him the tidings of a youth knowing.
verse.verse_29: Then his wife drew near vociferating, and smote her face, and said: an old barren woman!
verse.verse_30: They said: even so saith thine Lords Verily He! He is the Wise, the Knower.
verse.verse_31: He said: what then is your errand! O ye sent ones!
verse.verse_32: They said: verily we are sent Unto a people, guilty.
verse.verse_33: That we may send down upon them stones of baked clay.
verse.verse_34: Marked, from before thy Lord, for extravagant.
verse.verse_35: Thus We brought forth from there in who were believers.
verse.verse_36: And We found not therein more than one house of the Muslims.
verse.verse_37: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the afflictive torment.
verse.verse_38: And in Musa also was a lesson, when We sent him Unto Fir'awn with authority manifest.
verse.verse_39: Then he turned away with his court, and said: a magician or a madman.
verse.verse_40: Then We laid hold of him and his hosts and flung them into the sea, and he was reproachable.
verse.verse_41: And in `A-ad also was a lesson, when We sent against them the barren wind.
verse.verse_42: It left not aught whereon it came but it made it as matter decayed.
verse.verse_43: And in Thamud's also was a lesson, when it was said Unto them: enjoy yourselves for a season.
verse.verse_44: Then they disdained the command of their Lord; wherefore the bolt laid hold of them even while they looked on.
verse.verse_45: So they were not able to stand, nor could they help themselves.
verse.verse_46: And the people of Nuh We destroyed aforetime; verily they were a people transgressing.
verse.verse_47: And the heaven! We have built it with might, and verily We are powerful.
verse.verse_48: And the earth! We have stretched it forth beneath; an excellent Spreader are We!
verse.verse_49: And of every thing We have created pairs, that haply ye may remember.
verse.verse_50: Flee therefore Unto Allah; verily I am Unto you from Him a warner manifest.
verse.verse_51: And set not up another god with Allah; verily I am Unto you from Him a warner manifest.
verse.verse_52: Likewise, there came not an apostle Unto those before them but they said: a magician or a madman!
verse.verse_53: Have they bequeathed its Unto each other! Nay! they are a people contumacious.
verse.verse_54: So turn away thou from them, not thou art blameworthy.
verse.verse_55: And admonish, for verily admonition profiteth the believers.
verse.verse_56: And have not created the Jinn and mankind but that they should worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I seek not any provision from them, nor I desire that they should feed Me.
verse.verse_58: Verily Allah! He is the Provider, Owner of power, Firm.
verse.verse_59: So verily Unto those who do wrong there is a portion like Unto the portion of their fellows; wherefore let them not ask Me to hasten on.
verse.verse_60: Woe, then, Unto those who disbelieve in their Day which they are promised.
